## AstroGuard – AI-Powered Astronaut Health and Safety Monitoring System

AstroGuard is an AI-powered astronaut health and safety monitoring platform designed to support crew wellbeing during space missions. It brings together health information from wearable devices, environmental sensors, and other data sources into a unified monitoring dashboard. The system uses AI, machine learning, and data analytics to identify unusual health patterns, analyze reports, evaluate potential risks, and generate alerts with guidance for astronauts and mission support teams.

AstroGuard also incorporates an NLP-powered voice assistant that allows astronauts to interact with the system through voice commands and receive health-related information. Its mental wellbeing module explores audio-based indicators and voluntary check-ins, while its environmental monitoring module aims to identify potential space-weather and spacecraft environmental hazards.

By combining health monitoring, intelligent analysis, voice interaction, and environmental risk awareness, AstroGuard aims to improve astronaut safety, support timely decision-making, and contribute to healthier and safer human space exploration.
details:
AstroGuard – AI-Powered Astronaut Health and Safety Monitoring System

AstroGuard is an intelligent astronaut health and safety monitoring platform designed to support astronauts and mission support teams during space missions. It provides a centralized dashboard to monitor crew health indicators, wellbeing information, mission alerts and environmental conditions.

How it works: The platform is designed to combine data from wearable devices such as Actiwatch, Astroskin, BioButton and other compatible sensors through data uploads and future device integrations. The dashboard displays health indicators, historical trends and alerts. Its AI-powered voice assistant allows astronauts to ask health-related questions using natural language. It uses speech recognition, NLP and text-to-speech to understand questions and communicate responses. The prototype includes local Whisper speech recognition, a FastAPI backend and Gemini-powered medical information responses. It also includes a small set of reference-based first-aid responses.

Benefits and intended impact: AstroGuard aims to help identify unusual health patterns, improve access to health information, support timely medical-team communication and increase awareness of potential space-environment hazards. Its planned AI and machine-learning modules will support health-report analysis, risk evaluation, mental wellbeing trend monitoring and environmental hazard prediction.

Tools and technologies: Python, FastAPI, React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Whisper, Gemini API, NumPy and HTTP-based communication.

Creativity and innovation: AstroGuard combines wearable health monitoring, multilingual voice interaction, AI-assisted health information and environmental safety awareness in one platform. It is designed with modular components so additional devices and analytical capabilities can be integrated over time.

Factors considered: We considered limited connectivity, offline operation, different wearable-device formats, astronaut privacy, data accuracy, resource limitations and the importance of human medical supervision. The prototype uses clearly labelled synthetic demonstration data where live device data is unavailable. It is intended as a decision-support prototype, not a replacement for qualified medical professionals or approved mission procedures.
